outer_cv: KFold over 419 unique tasks; all three repeats of a task remain in the same fold
target: anchor repeat failure = reliability < 1 or quality < 0.6
verifier: class-balanced LogisticRegression(C=1, max_iter=2000) on train-fitted word TF-IDF plus deterministic response-consistency features
specialist_selection: one specialist per outer fold, selected only on training task-repeat mean utility
decision: accept anchor below the risk-specific predicted-failure threshold; otherwise escalate
bootstrap_unit: task after averaging its three repeat outcomes
pass_action: freeze architecture, then prepare a new untouched v4 protocol before collecting outcomes
fail_action: do not tune on v3; audit verifier recall and escalation precision on development data
